name: wizard
about: Boss Rush: the player's wizard duellist (2026-11-23): an original spellcaster in a knee-length indigo robe-coat with neon cyan and magenta circuit trim, a violet cape lined in magenta, a bent-tipped indigo hat with a cyan band, the face behind a high collar with two calm cyan eyes, gauntlets, a belt of glowing vials, armoured boots. Tripo H3.1 from concept wizard-a-nb-0 (Nano Banana Pro; a Rodin Gen-2.5 candidate from the same concept was not used: a pale face and hands, a smeared cape); rigged by Tripo (rig v3.0, biped); eight clips retargeted from Tripo's presets (two requests). Its soft skin is kept (a coat and a cape should bend: process-skinned.mjs), with a flutter mask for the cape and the coat's skirts.
bar: the game's one quality bar for a hero model (2026-11-17): 2048 px colour, 1024 px other maps, about 55K triangles (here 32K: a figure seen from behind, half of it under the answers)
perf: 2026-11-23: one-sided (the mesh is closed: the same picture) and no normal map (no difference seen at the game's size): its own drawing cost halved in both engines (tools/scenarios: an interleaved benchmark, shown against hidden)
